text:
omar-infra: Hey folks — new customer account 012345678901 needs GPU capacity in ap-southeast-1. Requesting increases: p5.48xlarge: 4 -> 12, p4d.24xlarge: 0 -> 6, g5.12xlarge: 8 -> 20. Also need ENI bump to 2000 and EBS throughput. Need this for a performance benchmark starting next Tue. Any blockers?

priya-cloudops: What's the use-case? prod or perf testing? We need cost center + short justification to include in the AWS support case. Also confirm whether we hit EC2 vCPU quotas.

omar-infra: It's perf testing for a Dedicated pilot, not customer-facing prod yet. Cost center: ENG-GPU-ALPHA, tag `redwood:cost_center=eng-gpu-alpha`. Account ID: 012345678901. Will run 24/7 for ~2 weeks.

alex-sre: FYI p5 capacity in ap-southeast-1 is tight right now. Recommend adding preferred AZs (ap-southeast-1a/1b) and a cross-region fallback to ap-southeast-2 or ap-east-1. Also plan to create capacity reservations asap once quotas are approved. :warning:

omar-infra: Submitted service quota requests and opened a support case. Case #1234567890. CLI I used for the service-quota request (example):
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-XXXXXXXX --desired-value 12 --region ap-southeast-1
```

aws-support-bot: Support case 1234567890 created. Please attach business justification and a short benchmark plan. Typical ETA for quota changes is 2-5 business days; request account rep escalation for faster handling.

finance-team: Please add an approved chargeback before we spin up >$30k/mo. Tagging as OK if you attach the ENG-GPU-ALPHA code to all instances. Ping us if you want a temporary dev spending approval.

omar-infra: Updated the case with the justification and uploaded the benchmark schedule. Also requested ENI and EBS throughput increases (current ENI 800 -> desired 2000).

aws-support-bot: Update on case 1234567890: ENI quota increase approved to 2000. p4d.24xlarge request pending (capacity check). p5.48xlarge partially approved to 8 for now. See console: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567890

priya-cloudops: Partial approval is fine. We can start with a mix: 4 p5 + 4 g5 to begin and iterate. Can someone add a quick cost estimate for that mix? Also we need a maintenance window for node bootstrap and any kernel updates.

alex-sre: I'll set up capacity reservations, placement groups, and an autoscaling policy tuned for inference workloads. Will tag nodes with `env:perf` and `team:eng`. ETA: tomorrow PM. :thumbsup:

omar-infra: Thanks — I'll escalate the p4d request with our AWS account manager and ask about availability in ap-east-1 or us-west-2 as fallback. If p4d can't be secured, fallback options are p3dn or a mix of g5+multi-node batching.

aws-support-bot: Case 1234567890 update: p4d capacity constrained in ap-southeast-1; recommended to request in ap-east-1 or us-west-2 instead. Marking case for escalation if you confirm an alternate region.

finance-team: We approve the temporary spend for the benchmark under ENG-GPU-ALPHA. Please confirm when instances are live and include hourly burn estimate.

priya-cloudops: Final checklist: once p5/g5 nodes are up run the perf smoke harness, post SLO metrics to #eng-infra, and validate billing tags. I'll close the thread when SLOs look good.

omar-infra: Will do. Thanks everyone — I'll post updates when the p5/g5 nodes are provisioned or if the p4d escalation succeeds.
